close_reason: Won't fix: P4-opinion-only stylistic preference. Per AGENTS.md convergence rule, P4/opinion findings under a converged review epic are bikeshedding-threshold. The current 'pub use jmap_calendars_types::JMAP_CALENDARS_URI' is a valid facade pattern; adding crate-local consts for the two PLAN.md-listed additional URIs (availability, parse) is defensible additive convenience. description:
src/lib.rs:55-56:

    /// Capability URI for `urn:ietf:params:jmap:calendars`.
    pub use jmap_calendars_types::JMAP_CALENDARS_URI;

The capability URI is conceptually a wire-protocol constant, more naturally owned by the protocol/types crate. Re-exporting from the server crate is fine. But the rustdoc presentation could be clearer:
- A reader of jmap-calendars-server expects to find calendar-specific things here. They reach for JMAP_CALENDARS_URI and get a re-export from another crate (no body documentation).
- Two additional capability URIs from PLAN.md §Capability URI (line 76-79) — urn:ietf:params:jmap:principals:availability and urn:ietf:params:jmap:calendars:parse — are not exposed at all from this crate.

Two options:
1. Define const PRINCIPALS_AVAILABILITY_URI and PARSE_URI here, alongside the re-export, so all three capability constants are discoverable from the server crate.
2. Move all three to jmap-calendars-types and re-export all three.

Either is fine. Current state has just one of three. The user constructing a Session capability struct has to grep multiple crates to find them.

P4/opinion. Not a bug. May coordinate with PLAN.md Capability URI section (lines 76-79).

JMAP-231o.16 in the calendars-client review filed a parallel observation about per-method-family capability URI sets being constants — same theme on the client side.
title: Capability URI re-exported from jmap_calendars_types — consider crate-local const for clearer dep direction
